# Disclosure

Wraps the agent's visible reasoning so users can audit each stage.

`SuDuAI.Disclosure` · Surfaces

## Use

```jsx
<SuDuAI.Disclosure title={…}>…</SuDuAI.Disclosure>
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="SuDuAI.Disclosure" title="{{…}}">…</x-import>
```

## Notes

Collapsible panel for agent reasoning traces and secondary detail.

## Props (DisclosureProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` * | `React.ReactNode` | label-md semibold header. |
| `meta` | `React.ReactNode` | Parenthetical label-sm meta, e.g. "(Resolved in 4 stages • 1,420 ms)". |
| `icon` | `string` | Leading Material Symbols glyph. Default "psychology_alt". |
| `children` | `React.ReactNode` |  |
| `defaultOpen` | `boolean` | Open on mount. Default true — reasoning is shown, not hidden. |
